title: Neukom Postdoctoral Fellows
institution: The Neukom Institute for Computational Science, Dartmouth College
about: Two-year postdoctoral fellowships (third year on request) at Dartmouth's Neukom Institute for computational research in any discipline, starting September 1, 2027. Applications close December 1, 2026; letters are due December 8, 2026.
requirements: PhD in any discipline, or expected by September 1, 2027
Letters of recommendation due by December 8, 2026

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: field "Computational science (any discipline)" -> objective "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling" (field-level fit; the stated requirements are a PhD and application procedure)
